description: Prospect site built on spec for Garage Martin & Martin (Google: « Garage Martin et Martin », 17525, rue de la Paix, Mirabel QC, 450-419-5222, 4.8★/89). Sources: the Google Business listing (hours, phone, address) and the garage's own GEM-CAR website site.gem-car.com/mecaniquestjerome (their words, services, oil-change price, email), which brands the same shop « Mécanique St-Jérôme ». The garage had no logo: a new enamel-badge logo was designed (gpt-image-2.5).

customConfig.businessAddress: 17525, rue de la Paix, Mirabel (Québec) J7J 1M3

designManifest.summary: The brand is a porcelain-enamel garage sign (navy field, ivory letters, signal-red pinstripe) — the new logo. Knowledge is a patent drawing: ivory linework on navy, every illustration captioned FIG. nn. Flows (booking, account) are a shop ticket on paper. The ampersand — two Martins — is the recurring separator.
designManifest.signatureMove: The headline is their own promise — « Tout, sauf la carrosserie. » — and a « Votre gabarit » selector that re-sorts tires and rust-proofing by vehicle size (voiture · VUS · pick-up · gros pick-up), the way their own price list is split.
designManifest.typography: Archivo variable (wdth 108–122, 750–900) display, Archivo 400–700 text, Playfair Display 700 for the ampersand, JetBrains Mono for FIG./ticket labels.
